original_execution: null only for actual empty-initial. checkpoint binds execution_id,object_generation,request_digest,container_id,exec_id,volume_id,freeze_generation and original stopped/prepared state; X checks association not Pi semantics.

archive_required.sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal of exact archive bytes

entries: object from unique canonical POSIX member path to exact entry, root . mandatory; no empty/absolute/NUL/dotdot path, every parent actual directory; reject duplicates, special device/FIFO/socket/sparse/unsupported encoding

metadata_required.mode: integer permission bits0..4095 exact, never chmod-to-read as silent conversion
metadata_required.mtime_ns: signed integer ns representable on target Linux; PAX decimal parsed exactly, never via float
metadata_required.xattrs: must be {}, ACL/xattr unsupported in current tmpfs; reject before losing data

symlink_required.target_base64: original filesystem link bytes, never followed during import/export; no archive extraction through link ancestor

hardlink_required.target: canonical regular original member, same inode group and consistent metadata; count logical storage once

complete_set: No ignored files/empty dirs lost. Every archive member and actual private tree member corresponds exactly once; all expected hashes/lengths from independent files/tar, never candidate booleans. max512entries/16MiB logical includes root and all extra work files.
empty_initial: actual original archive containing only . (dir,mode0700,uid1000,gid1000,mtime_ns0,xattrs{}), matching actual original manifest, logical_bytes0, origin empty-initial and original_execution null. No invented empty string/no-file reference.
external_authority: S owns original snapshot meaning and authorization. X checks full record/reference/files and preserves raw bytes. PREPARED does not mean stopped; copied archive with missing actual stop cannot authorize F install or old namespace replacement. Session snapshots never installed as Surface/Workspace.
raw_member_name: Raw GNU tar permits exactly one leading ./, removed only for canonical manifest key. Archive bytes are retained unchanged; duplicate names after normalization reject. Empty/internal-dot/dotdot/absolute paths still reject.
